title: Coward (bc30)
synopsis:
Amid World War I, an array of young Belgian soldiers arrives at the Western Front. Pierre, a taciturn young man from a village, is eager to prove himself. However, repeated trips to retrieve bodies of his comrades begin to instill fear in him and shatter his faith. Meanwhile, Francis, an exuberant lead performer of the army asks Pierre to help out with the set. With the war, Francis turns the impossible into possible, freely navigating between male and female, captivating those in uniform with the most tender and luring glances. While the battle continues to escalate outside the camp, a tender romance begins to blossom between Pierre and Francis.

Following his Grand Jury Prize win with Close, award-winning director Lukas Dhont returns to Cannes with another stunning work that casts a poignant romantic spell against a turbulent era. Making their Cannes debut, the two male leads won the Best Actor award with their moving performances.
cast: Valentin Campagne, Emmanuel Macchia, Willem De Schryver
